department: Civil, Environmental & Architectural Engineering (Civil Engineering PhD)

deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is December 2, 2026; the final deadline is August 1.

app_fee.value: The department catalog lists the international application fee as $85.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for admission.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not required for admission

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required for admission.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not required for admission

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The priority deadlines are for consideration for fellowships and assistantships; the catalog does not say most students are funded.

entry_route.value: An ABET-accredited bachelor's in engineering is required, and direct entry from the bachelor's is covered.
entry_route.quote: An ABET-accredited baccalaureate degree in engineering, or the equivalent from abroad, is required for admission to the Ph.D. degree program in civil engineering

also.quote: Students admitted to the doctoral degree program directly from the bachelor's degree

notes: The same department catalog also lists an Environmental & Water Resources Engineering PhD (catalog.ku.edu/engineering/civil-environmental-architectural-engineering/phd-environmental-water-resources-engineering/) with the same deadlines, GRE rule and $85 international fee. It is covered here through also_fields.
